identityImport.title: Bring your data to Pipeup?
identityImport.description: Pipeup now keeps its data separate from OpenTypeless. We found data under the older shared identity. You can copy it into Pipeup or start fresh. The old data stays in place either way.
identityImport.quitOldApp: Quit OpenTypeless or an older Pipeup build before importing. If you run both apps, give them different keyboard shortcuts.
identityImport.imported: Data copied. Restart Pipeup to load it.
identityImport.keysToReenter: Some provider keys could not be copied. Re-enter these in Settings: {{providers}}.
identityImport.checkKeys: The old credential store could not be read. Check your provider keys in Pipeup after restarting.

home.description: Hold your keyboard shortcut, speak, then release to insert your words into the focused app.
home.toggleDescription: Press your keyboard shortcut to start speaking. Press it again to finish and insert your words.
home.dictionaryHint: Names, technical terms, and words you use often
home.setupHint: These are your saved settings. Check your provider connection in Dictation before your first recording.

onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Set up voice input with your own API keys.
onboarding.speechRecognitionDesc: Configure your ASR service to convert speech to text
onboarding.aiPolishDesc: Configure an LLM service to polish transcribed text
onboarding.tryItOutDesc: Hold the button and say something to test the full pipeline
onboarding.speakToWrite: Speak to write - turn your voice into polished text in real time
onboarding.selectLanguageDesc: Select the language for the app interface. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.connectionFailed: Connection failed, please check your API Key
onboarding.connectionFailedConfig: Connection failed, please check your config
onboarding.speechSubtitle: Choose a provider and test your connection.
onboarding.aiSubtitle: Turn this off to use transcription without an AI provider.
onboarding.demoSubtitle: A preview of dictation in another app.
onboarding.saveFailed: Your setup could not be saved. Please try again.
onboarding.pressShortcut: Press {{shortcut}} to start or stop recording.
onboarding.demoPhase3: Text appears in your focused app
onboarding.demoPolished: Hello, can you help me with this?
onboarding.demoRaw: hello um can you help me with this

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Pipeup needs two macOS permissions to record and paste. Granting them now means dictation works on first try.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.settingsHint: In System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility, enable Pipeup. The old OpenTypeless entry belongs to the previous app identity and does not grant Pipeup access.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clickToConfirm: Click again to confirm, or press another combination
settings.geminiTranscribeLiveHint: Gemini transcribes while you speak, so text appears within about half a second of stopping. Uses your saved Gemini key.
settings.apiKeyUnreadable: Could not read your saved credential.
settings.apiKeyUnreadableHint: Check access to credential storage and try again. Entering a key replaces the stored value.
settings.apiKeyUnencrypted: Stored unencrypted in local app data. On macOS and Linux, the file is readable only by your account.
settings.storedLocally: Stored locally in your account, never in a settings file.
settings.sttLanguagesAutoHint: Auto Detect - speak any supported language.
settings.sttLanguagesSingleHint: Optimized for the selected language; others may transcribe less reliably.
settings.sttLanguagesMultiHint: Auto-detect among your selections; polish will favor these.
settings.selectedTextEditingDesc: Select text, hold the hotkey and speak an instruction - "fix the grammar", "make this shorter" - and the selection is replaced with the result. The capsule shows an amber ring while recording whenever a selection was found; no ring means the dictation will be inserted as usual. Browsers and Electron apps (Cursor, VS Code, Slack) do not expose their selection to macOS, so editing does not reach them.
settings.selectedTextEditingRequiresPolish: Requires AI processing. Enable it above to edit selected text by voice.
settings.selectedTextEditingMacOnly: macOS only - reading the selection needs Accessibility, which has no equivalent on this platform.
settings.aboutDescription: Voice input for your desktop, with your choice of speech and AI providers.
settings.retentionHintForever: Entries are kept until you delete them.
settings.retentionHintDays: Entries older than {{days}} days are deleted automatically, including ones already saved and even while saving is off.
settings.retentionConfirm:
Keep history for {{days}} days?

Entries older than that will be deleted when you save. This cannot be undone.
settings.translationRequiresAi: Enable AI processing to translate dictation.
settings.privacyHint: Audio is sent directly to your speech provider. If AI processing is enabled, text is sent to your AI provider. History and dictionary entries stay on this device.

dictionary.noEntries: No entries yet. Add proper nouns to improve recognition accuracy.

learnFromCorrections.label: Learn from corrections (experimental)
learnFromCorrections.description: After dictation, Pipeup watches your edits for ~15 s and offers to add fixed names and terms here. Reads the focused text field via macOS Accessibility - you'll be prompted to grant the permission on first use.

dictionary.savedImmediately: Words are saved as you add or remove them. Preference changes use the Save button.

history.title: History
history.noHistoryHint: Press your hotkey to start recording and your transcriptions will appear here.
history.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all history? This cannot be undone.
history.savingDisabled: Saving is off - new dictations won't be recorded here. Entries below stay, but your retention setting still applies to them.
history.recentLimit: Search your most recent 200 dictations. Clearing history removes all saved entries.
